changelog:
v4.2.4 — 4K movie playback fix

• 4K movies (including Dolby Vision) now play in HARDWARE on 4K-capable devices like the Fire TV Stick 4K and 4K Max — no more stuttering, slideshow, black screen, or crashing on these titles.
• If your device is NOT 4K-capable, 4K titles now tell you right away ("This is a 4K title — this device can't decode it. Try a 1080p or HD version.") instead of freezing or crashing. 4K movies require a 4K streaming device.
• Smoother 4K playback on capable devices — a bigger buffer rides out brief connection dips instead of stalling.
• Fixed a rare app crash on some 4K HDR titles.
• Fixed movies in "Continue Watching" failing to play after your provider changed servers — broken shortcuts are now cleaned up automatically and rebuilt against the current server.
• Fixed some generic Android TV boxes getting stuck on the Home screen.

Non-4K playback is unchanged.
